CVET's unaired community-television news pilot, Woodstock, Cape Town, 3 Jan 1992: studio anchor at a COMMUNITY NEWS desk describing the area it transmits to, then Chris Hani (SACP) and Allan Boesak (ANC Western Cape) addressing 500 people on CODESA, jobs, housing and a two-year transitional government.
